candidates.name: Saving Soren
candidates.description:
A crypto-native dad who's been in the space for 10 years just posted his newborn son Soren's mint address. The baby was born three days ago with a rare heart defect and is fighting for his life, and his father is asking the community he's never asked anything from to show up.

Hey, my name is Samuel del Real. Some of you know me, a lot of you don't. I've been in the blockchain and crypto space for ten years. Three days ago, I became a dad. It was the most beautiful moment of my life. But my son was born with a rare birth defect within his heart and right now he's fighting for his life. In ten years in this space, I've never asked for anything. I've only ever given it everything I had. The projects, the communities, the work, the late nights, all of it, because I believe this is the future. Today I'm coming to you humbly, asking for support. I launched a token because I believe in blockchain and I think this is a real way to raise awareness for what my family is going through. Thank you.
